# The Modern Proper

> > A modern recipe website featuring quick, accessible home cooking with an emphasis on fresh ingredients, dietary flexibility, and approachable techniques.

Founded by Holly Erickson and Natalie Mortimer, The Modern Proper offers a collection of contemporary recipes that balance flavor with convenience. The site specializes in weeknight-friendly meals, seasonal cooking, and adaptable dishes that accommodate gluten-free, vegetarian, dairy-free, and other dietary preferences.

## Key Topics

- gluten-free recipes
- vegetarian and vegan options
- quick dinner ideas (30-minute meals)
- Mediterranean-inspired dishes
- one-pot meals
- dairy-free cooking
- low-carb options
- kid-friendly recipes
- grilling and summer recipes
- meal prep techniques
- Instant Pot cooking
- seasonal ingredients
- healthy salads
- easy weeknight dinners

## Quick Weeknight Dinners

- [Broiled Salmon](https://themodernproper.com/broiled-salmon): Quick broiled salmon with simple sauce - 30-min gluten-free dinner
- [One-Pot Chicken with Creamed Kale](https://themodernproper.com/one-pot-chicken-with-creamed-kale): One-pot chicken with Parmesan creamed kale and Castelvetrano olives
- [Spicy Chili Crisp Noodles with Salmon](https://themodernproper.com/spicy-chili-crisp-noodles-with-salmon): 5-minute spicy chili crisp udon noodles with tinned salmon
- [Pasta with Tomato Cream Sauce](https://themodernproper.com/pasta-with-tomato-cream-sauce): Easy pasta with tomato cream sauce, basil, and Parmigiano-Reggiano
- [Thai Fried Rice with Basil](https://themodernproper.com/thai-fried-rice-with-basil): Thai basil fried rice with chicken and jasmine rice - takeout alternative

## Salads & Light Meals

- [Southwest Style Cobb Salad with Smoky Chipotle Dressing](https://themodernproper.com/southwest-style-cobb-salad-with-smoky-chipotle-dressing): Grilled Southwest cobb salad with smoky chipotle mayo dressing
- [Grilled Steak Salad with Blue Cheese Dressing](https://themodernproper.com/grilled-steak-salad-with-blue-cheese-dressing): Skirt steak and grilled romaine salad with homemade blue cheese dressing
- [Italian Chopped Salad](https://themodernproper.com/italian-chopped-salad): No-cook Italian chopped salad - gluten-free main dish
- [Easy Niçoise Salad](https://themodernproper.com/easy-nicoise-salad): Classic French Niçoise salad from Nice - 30-min gluten-free tuna salad
- [Spinach Orzo Salad With Feta, Tomatoes and a Basil Dressing](https://themodernproper.com/spinach-orzo-salad-with-feta-tomatoes-and-a-basil-dressing): Mediterranean spinach orzo pasta salad with feta, tomatoes, and basil
- [Chickpea Salad](https://themodernproper.com/chickpea-salad): Vegan Mediterranean chickpea salad with cucumber and pepperoncini

## Special Occasion & Roasts

- [Pork Loin Roast](https://themodernproper.com/pork-loin-roast): Festive pork loin roast with apples, root veggies, and cider gravy
- [Instant Pot Ribs](https://themodernproper.com/instant-pot-ribs): Fall-off-bone Instant Pot baby back ribs with Asian-inspired sauce

## Appetizers & Small Plates

- [Sticky Shrimp Lettuce Wraps](https://themodernproper.com/sticky-shrimp-lettuce-wraps): Asian-inspired sticky shrimp lettuce wraps with honey-garlic-chili sauce
- [Tomato and Avocado Bruschetta](https://themodernproper.com/tomato-and-avocado-bruschetta): Italian bruschetta with avocado and tomato - vegan appetizer
- [Egg Cups](https://themodernproper.com/egg-cups): Baked breakfast egg cups with spinach and feta - meal prep friendly

## Recipe Collections & Guides

- [20 Best Cauliflower Recipes](https://themodernproper.com/20-best-cauliflower-recipes): Roundup of 20 best cauliflower recipes - roasted and healthy alternatives
- [How To Make A Hot Dog](https://themodernproper.com/how-to-make-a-hot-dog): Guide to cooking hot dogs with grilling tips and methods

## Sides & Basics

- [Homemade French Fries](https://themodernproper.com/homemade-french-fries): Crispy homemade french fries using double-frying method
- [Fried Shallots](https://themodernproper.com/fried-shallots): Crispy fried shallots - vegan gluten-free garnish topping
